$comment: THE PORT MAP for the unified-data campaign's concurrent builder lanes.
WHY. ATTACK-9 finding 26: the build book's peak is seven concurrent builders,
each of which §5.9 gives 'per-process overrides on this lane's own dev server',
in ONE shared working tree, with no port allocation anywhere in the plan. Two
lanes that both reach for the default port do not fail loudly: the second one
either binds a port Next.js picked for it and the lane then drives a browser at
the address it THINKS it owns, or it attaches to the first lane's server and
verifies the first lane's environment overrides while believing they are its
own. Both produce a green screenshot of the wrong system.
THE RULE. A lane never runs a bare `pnpm dev` and never guesses a port. It reads
its port from this file and passes it explicitly. Prove the machine is ready:
pnpm check:campaign-ports              (whole map: duplicates, range, occupancy)
pnpm check:campaign-ports --lane W6-CHAT   (just mine: is my port free right now)
3001 IS NOT A LANE PORT. CLAUDE.md § Dev server makes 3001 the ONE dev server
machine-wide (`pnpm preview:start`), shared by every non-campaign agent in this
checkout. A lane that took 3001 would evict them. It is listed here anyway so
the duplicate check covers it and nobody re-allocates it by accident.
ONE HOST PER LANE, TOO. Cookies are per host, not per port, so a lane also opens
its own `http://<lane>.localhost:<port>` hostname — see CLAUDE.md § Dev server.
Two lanes on two ports but one `localhost` host still share one session and one
dev-login will evict the other.

portRange.$comment: Widened 3050 -> 3060 by lane FIX-14 (2026-09-22): all fifty of the original slots were allotted, so a new lane had no honest port left and the only alternatives were squatting on a finished lane's row or guessing — which is the exact failure this map exists to prevent. Widened 3060 -> 3062 by lane ARGS-RULED-2 (2026-09-24) for its headless Share-dialog walk on the dev clone; every slot was allotted. Widened 3062 -> 3063 by lane ROUTE-RESOLVER (2026-09-24) for its /o/<id> walk on the dev clone. Widened 3063 -> 3065 by lane S0-ONE-SAVED-VIEW (2026-09-24) for its records-ui harness walk on the dev clone; every slot was allotted and 3064 was held by an unlisted Next.js server. Widened 3065 -> 3066 by lane S4-BATCH-DOORS (2026-09-24) for its records-ui harness walk of the batch move and batch decide on the dev clone; every slot was allotted.

reserved.why: The one machine-wide dev server every non-campaign agent in this shared checkout uses. Never allocated to a lane.

noDevServer.W6-DOCS: Proves its contract through the document pipeline, not a browser.
noDevServer.W6-EXT: Drives the Chrome extension harness, which brings its own host.
noDevServer.W6-LOCAL: Drives matrx-local (Tauri + Python sidecar); its own ports, not Next.js.
noDevServer.V6: Verifier. §2's peak is seven builders AND NO VERIFIER, so V6 borrows the port of whichever lane it is re-verifying, which is finished by then.
noDevServer.DATA-HUB: Verifies on the machine-wide preview server (port 3001, the reserved one). A PreToolUse hook on this box refuses a second Next.js dev server outright — 16GB, and two is a reliable hard crash — so this lane takes no port of its own rather than squatting on one it cannot start.
